taskHistory.title: Task history limit
taskHistory.description: How many old task records Docker keeps for each service slot. Docker prunes the records; the janitor removes the leftover containers. TierPlan never changes this on its own.
taskHistory.helper: Docker's default is {{default}}. 0 keeps no task history, so you can't see why a task stopped.
taskHistory.noManager: No manager is connected, so TierPlan can't read or change the limit.
taskHistory.error: Use a whole number from 0 to 1000.
taskHistory.saveFailed: Couldn't change the task history limit.
taskHistory.swarmChanged: The swarm changed while TierPlan was saving. Try again.
taskHistory.agentPolicyDenied: Update the agent on a manager to change this limit.
taskHistory.hostReadOnly: This host is read-only. Changes are turned off on the host itself, so TierPlan can only read from it.
taskHistory.loadFailed: Couldn't read the task history limit.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.caption: Skip a fragile node, or keep more of its task containers. Every other setting follows the environment.
nodes.keepError: Use a whole number from 0 to 20.
nodes.saveFailed: Couldn't change the janitor setting for {{node}}.
nodes.notFound: {{node}} is no longer in this swarm. Reload the page to see the current nodes.
